event: She pays two copper for a pallet in the Brook and Barrel's common room and sleeps the night through.
At first light the five of them walk down to Tull's ford.
The ford runs knee-deep, ten paces wide, thirty paces out from the trees.
A drystone sheep wall runs along the meadow bank. Merrit pats it. "Here. They bunch in the water."
Dace sets them along the wall. "Bring them out to us, and don't get caught doing it."
Nala crosses alone and goes up the deer trail, off it among the bushes, slow and quiet.
Every little while she lets her sense spread wide.
A mile and more in, her sense brushes something: two bodies, forty paces ahead, coming down.
Goblins, small and silent, slipping from tree to tree beside the trail. Neither turns her way.
Behind them, out past her reach, comes a low muttering, many voices. A heavy tread among them.
